name: STAT 6325
title: Advanced Probability
description: Fundamentals of measure and integration theory: fields, o-fields, and measures; extension of measures; Lebesgue-Stieltjes measures and distribution functions; measurable functions and integration theorems; the Radon-Nikodym Theorem, product measures, and Fubini's Theorem. Introduction to measure-theoretic probability: probability spaces and random variables; expectation and moments; independence, conditioning, the Borel-Cantelli Lemmas, and other topics as time allows.
requirement_description: Open to Ph.D. students who have passed the Ph.D. Qualifying Exam in Statistics, others with permission.
